📰 Crypto Market Hotspot Delivery

1. Ethereum Foundation restructures and upgrades; protocol coordination team disbanded
The Ethereum Foundation has recently moved forward with an organizational restructure. Against the backdrop of cutting roughly two staff members, the protocol support team responsible for coordinating core development has been dissolved. The team had long carried out functions such as organizing core developer meetings, tracking network upgrades, supporting the EIP process, and mentoring new contributors. Reports indicate that the relevant personnel will remain at the Foundation, but how the team’s functions will be taken over going forward has become a focus of market attention. This move signals that the Ethereum Foundation may further compress its architecture and improve execution efficiency, and it could also affect ecosystem governance and the pace of upgrade coordination.

2. Metaplanet partners with multiple parties to research Bitcoin-backed digital credit
The Japanese listed company Metaplanet is working with entities such as JPYC and Progmat to explore digital credit products backed by Bitcoin. The core direction is to tokenize BTC collateral for debt instruments that accrue daily interest and can be traded and settled around the clock. Its securities platform will also participate in product design and sales. Metaplanet currently holds a large amount of BTC and plans to use it as a compliant collateral asset and credit enhancement tool to meet the financing needs of Japanese mid-sized and growth-stage enterprises. This development shows that Bitcoin is extending beyond a reserve asset into on-chain credit and asset securitization scenarios.

3. Ledger discloses physical attack risks affecting Tangem hardware wallets
Ledger’s research team disclosed that Tangem hardware wallets have certain physical attack paths. After an attacker obtains the card and disassembles it, they can reset the password using high-cost laboratory equipment via laser pulses—allowing them to sign arbitrary transactions and transfer assets. This issue cannot be fixed via firmware upgrades because the relevant devices do not have an update mechanism. Although the attack threshold is high and cannot be executed remotely, once the device has been lost or is no longer under the holder’s control, security risks will rise significantly. The incident once again highlights the importance of cold wallets in terms of supply chain management, physical access, and upgradability.

4. CodexField account and official website taken offline; suspicious fund movements raise alarms
Security monitoring shows that both CodexField’s X account and its official website have currently been taken down. Previously, on-chain analysts had issued warnings about potential fraud and “rug pull” risks, and tracked abnormal cross-chain transfers of more than 17.3 million USDT. With social media and the website simultaneously unreachable, the project’s transparency declines further, and market concerns about where its liquidity went and whether operations are genuine have intensified quickly. Events like this remind users that when participating in new projects, they should especially verify the team’s background, the on-chain path of funds, and whether the platform continues to operate, and be wary of potential risks behind high-yield narratives.

5. Binance pushes Asian regulatory-compliance expansion; global user target points to 3 billion
Binance co-CEO Richard Teng said the platform plans to obtain more regulatory licenses in Asia this year and pursue more partnerships, with progress to be announced in stages thereafter. Currently, Binance has already carried out initiatives across multiple Asian markets and continues to strengthen communications with regulators. Management also emphasized that about one quarter of Binance’s employees focus on compliance work, and annual compliance spending exceeds $300 million. Looking ahead, Binance hopes to expand its global user base to 3 billion by 2030 and is optimistic about more tokenized trading of traditional financial assets on blockchain networks, highlighting the potential for the convergence of CeFi and RWA.

#ETH #BTC #Binance

📰 加密市场热点速递

1. 以太坊基金会重组升级，关键协议协调团队解散
以太坊基金会近期推进组织重组，在裁减约两成员工的背景下，负责核心开发协同的协议支持团队已被解散。该团队长期承担核心开发者会议组织、网络升级跟踪、EIP 流程支持及新贡献者培养等职能。消息显示，相关负责人仍将留在基金会，但团队职能后续如何承接，成为市场关注焦点。此举释放出以太坊基金会进一步压缩架构、提升执行效率的信号，也可能影响生态治理与升级协同节奏。

2. Metaplanet 联合多方研究比特币抵押数字信贷
日本上市公司 Metaplanet 正联合 JPYC、Progmat 等机构探索以比特币为抵押的数字信用产品，核心方向是将 BTC 抵押品通证化，用于按日计息、可全天候交易与结算的债务工具。其旗下证券平台也将参与产品设计与销售。Metaplanet 当前持有大规模 BTC，计划将其作为合规抵押资产与信用增强工具，服务日本中型及成长型企业融资需求。该动向显示，比特币正从储备资产进一步延伸至链上信用与资产证券化场景。

3. Ledger 披露 Tangem 硬件钱包物理攻击风险
Ledger 研究团队披露，Tangem 硬件钱包存在特定物理攻击路径，攻击者在取得卡片并进行拆解后，可借助高成本实验室设备通过激光脉冲重置密码，从而签署任意交易并转移资产。该问题无法通过固件升级修复，因为相关设备不具备更新机制。虽然攻击门槛高、无法远程实施，但一旦设备曾遗失或脱离持有人控制，安全风险将显著上升。事件再次凸显冷钱包在供应链、物理接触与可升级性方面的重要性。

4. CodexField 账号与官网下线，资金异动引发警惕
安全监测显示，CodexField 的 X 账号及官方网站目前均已下线。此前已有链上分析人士对该项目提出欺诈及跑路风险预警，并追踪到超过 1730 万枚 USDT 的异常跨链资金转移。随着社媒与官网同时失联，项目透明度进一步下降，市场对其流动性去向和运营真实性的担忧快速升温。此类事件提醒用户，在参与新项目时应重点核查团队背景、链上资金路径及平台持续运营情况，警惕高收益叙事背后的潜在风险。

5. 币安推进亚洲合规扩张，全球用户目标指向 30 亿
币安联席 CEO Richard Teng 表示，平台计划今年在亚洲获取更多监管牌照并推进更多合作，后续将陆续公布进展。当前币安已在多个亚洲市场开展布局，并持续强化与监管机构沟通。管理层同时强调，币安约四分之一员工专注合规工作，年度合规投入超过 3 亿美元。展望未来，币安希望到 2030 年将全球用户规模扩大至 30 亿，并看好更多传统金融资产在区块链网络上实现代币化交易，释放 CeFi 与 RWA 融合潜力。

#ETH #BTC #Binance

title: 链上风控的底牌：看懂 Newton Keystore 的权限“断层”操作
subTitle:
币圈待了快十年，“代码即法律”早成了一块破烂的遮羞布。天天看着池子被掏空、大户被割肉，这套去中心化的玩法有时候简直就是在裸奔。最近推特上全在刷 @NewtonProtocol 刚上线的 Newton Mainnet Beta，都在吹嘘它那个 VaultKit 模块有多神，说能在黑客拔线前就把非法指令直接掐断。#ETH $ETH #Newt 
乍一听，这不就是给 DeFi 赌桌加装了一道强力安检门吗？但大伙儿往往忽略了一个最刺眼的问题：假如某个网络能在你的交易盖章前就强行叫停，这玩意儿难道不就是一个彻头彻尾的“一言堂”？如今自动化交易满天飞，谁敢保证这个风控闸门干干净净，一点夹带私货的空间都没有？
顺着白皮书深挖，其实它里面藏得最深的，是一个叫 Newton Keystore 的基础设施。这东西可不是市面上那种换皮的资管插件，它本质上是个搞多方安全计算的权限隔离区。说白了，它是把“出主意的大脑”和“管钱袋子的手”给硬生生劈开了。
这种权限断层的设计挺绝的。哪怕是最外层的过滤规则被黑客污染了，或者跑数据的 AI 模型突然走火入魔，只要拿不到 Keystore 硬件级别的放行密钥，任何想要强行划转资金的野路子代码都只能是隔靴搔痒，根本碰不到底层的资产。
相比于圈内那种被盗了才想起来去打口水仗的“亡羊补牢”操作，这种把枪口向前的防守要实在得多。通过借用以太坊主网的安全冗余，再配上零知识证明给每次拦截上双重保险，这套风控地基打得够深。而 $NEWT 这个代币，就在里头扮演着维系惩罚节点的经济押金。
可是，老玩家心里都门儿清：这种重装铠甲在如今的市场情绪里根本卖不上价。当下的风气是啥？是无脑梭哈，是百倍暴富。你让散户去搞这套繁琐的防守机制，纯属劝退。所以 $NEWT 的技术底色，注定它只能去讨好那些对资金安全极其敏感的机构金库，散户根本不是它的基本盘。
再者，凡事都有代价。把防守阵线往前挪，等于把所有黑客的火力全引到了规则判定的那个靶心。万一预言机的报价瞬间被砸穿，或者风控逻辑自己卡出了死循环，这套标榜绝对安全的护城河，弄不好会变成套死用户本金的铁笼子。这一切，不放到主网里去被真实资金狠狠扒几层皮，谁都不敢打包票。
说到底，咱们在链上折腾来折腾去，无非是用冷冰冰的程序去锁住贪婪的人性。但你要想保住筹码，就必然要戴上审查的镣铐。这个项目的本质，不过是在丛林法则和绝对管制之间，强行划出了一片缓冲区。在这个充满算计的数字荒野里，它也就是一堵替大资金挡子弹的防波堤而已。

translatedData.title: The Trump Card of On-Chain Risk Control: Understand the “Permission Gap” Operation of the Newton Keystore
translatedData.subTitle:
I’ve been in the crypto circle for almost ten years—“code is law” has long become a tattered fig leaf. Watching pools get drained and whales get slaughtered every day, this so-called decentralized game sometimes feels like it’s running naked. Lately, Twitter has been flooded with @NewtonProtocol everything about the newly launched Newton Mainnet Beta#ETH  and people are praising how magical its VaultKit module is, saying it can directly cut off illegal instructions before a hacker can even pull the plug.<t-31/>#Newt 
At first glance, isn’t this just installing a powerful security checkpoint on the DeFi gambling table? But everyone often overlooks the most glaring question: if a network can forcibly halt things before your transactions get stamped, doesn’t that make it a total “one-person rule”? These days, automated trading is everywhere—who can guarantee this risk-control gate is clean and there’s absolutely no room for any hidden agenda?

title: 链上自由的妥协：拆解 $NEWT 的前置防御与中心化隐忧
subTitle:
别再拿“代码即法律”忽悠人了。在这个圈子摸爬滚打这么些年，眼睁睁看着各路协议花式被黑，合约代码早就成了黑客提款机。最近讨论度极高的 @NewtonProtocol 刚刚上线了 Newton Mainnet Beta，各种分析都在捧它的 VaultKit 组件，说这套逻辑能提前把恶意交易掐死在摇篮里。#ETH #newt $ETH 

听着确实挺玄乎，就像给失控的链上快车安了个智能急刹。但这里头有个容易被忽略的盲区：假若某个网络有资格在资产易手之前就进行“拦截”，那它本身岂不是变成了一个手握重权的审核者？当下的自动化金库天天跑那么多笔交互，凭啥认定这个风控枢纽干干净净没有猫腻？

顺着往下挖，白皮书里有个叫 Newton Keystore 的底层架构反而最值得琢磨。它有别于常规的钱包管理方案，核心思路是基于多方安全计算，硬生生把“权限”和“身份”切开了。通俗点说，就是负责“发号施令的大脑”跟“掌握资产底牌的双手”不再是同一个实体。

这种剥离设计相当狠。哪怕最前端的规则被黑客渗透，或者 AI 助手出了逻辑故障，只要没拿到 Keystore 硬件级别的通关文牒，任何企图转移资金的野鸡指令都白搭。

对比那些平时不作为、一出事就急着发推悬赏的马后炮机制，这套提前设卡的玩法显然更落地。靠着重质押借用以太坊的共识层，再配合零知识证明给拦截动作背书，整套防线搭得很稳，而 $NEWT 则充当了维持这套惩罚机制正常运转的经济燃料。

不过，站在散户的立场，这种硬核风控真没什么吸引力。眼下这浮躁的行情，大伙只关心怎么光速打狗、怎么拉盘，谁有闲工夫去走繁琐的安全验证？所以 $NEWT 走的注定是一条不被大众理解的高墙路线，它瞄准的是 B 端大户和专业资金盘。

退一步说，再厚的装甲也有软肋。拦截机制虽然把防线前置了，但也让攻击者的火力全对准了策略解析的那一刹那。一旦喂价数据源遭遇短时操纵，或是防火墙自身跑出个死循环，这套护城河会不会反过来把用户的钱给活活憋死在里头？这还得靠主网的真实流量来检验。

折腾来折腾去，链上金融无非是用死板的程序去填补人性的坑。但你要绝对的安全，就得交出绝对的自由。这个项目说白了，就是在失控的数字荒野和憋屈的铁笼之间，硬生生砸出了一条妥协的隔离带罢了。

title: Newton Protocol 深度刺穿：建立在流沙上的 $NEWT 虚假繁荣
subTitle:
咱们换个视角，把 Newton Protocol 这套账本彻底撕开看。整个身份验证体系里，源头的活水到底是谁给的？是那些苦哈哈对接政府接口、做实名认证的签发机构。他们砸下真金白银搞定人工复核与资质审查，硬生生把现实里的身份淬炼成了链上的W3C凭证。这帮人是点燃引擎的火石，没他们提供弹药，后续所有的智能合约授权全是一堆废代码。但吊诡的是，当你翻遍白皮书的利益分配细则，这群出钱出力的老实人，居然连个坐号都没排上。

这种剥夺绝不是写错了一两行字，而是写在机制基因里的算计。签发机构在给凭证盖戳的那一秒，就把合规、人工的庞大开销全吞进肚子里了。可是，当这个凭证落到持有人手里，开始在各大DApp里疯狂串门、每次触发验证程序时，白花花的银子就开始往下掉。这些钱，节点运营商分了，协议金库拿了，唯独最开始掏腰包定做凭证的那波人，彻底失去了对这件资产的管辖权，后续的源源流水跟他们半毛钱关系都没有。

按正常做买卖的规矩，你产出了高价值的资产，要么一次性宰个肥羊，要么细水长流收过路费。但在 Newton 的地盘上，持续收租的路子根本不通。签发机构只能在最开始收一笔初始的手续费。而在那种谁都能插一脚的公开市场里，同行之间互相压价，这笔钱只会无限逼近成本底线。明明这个凭证能在以后被反复调用产生巨大的溢价，这块最肥的肉却被别人端走了。干活的，成了这套系统里雷打不动的纯支出通道。

这时候你再瞅瞅 $NEWT 的持币群体，这帮人的位置就更有意思了。他们手里攥着的所谓协议分红，说白了，全是从签发机构早前垫付的信任成本里抠出来的。底层干活的人，开销是闷在水底的死账；而上面炒币的人，兜里进的却是看得见摸得着的活钱。这简直就是一台没被挂牌的抽血泵，悄无声息地把最底层产出的核心价值，一口口喂给了上层的食利阶层，而这套狸猫换太子的戏码被掩饰得极好。@NewtonProtocol 

我们可以盘算一笔最直白的账目。假设一家合规公司，一年老老实实地签发了100万个凭证。就算单次审核开销压到极致的 5美元，一年也得烧掉500万美金。这100万个凭证，假设这辈子平均被调取50次，每次给系统上交 0.1美元 的验证费。你猜怎么着？系统金库刚好也是进账500万美金。打工的硬掏500万开销，持币的稳收500万流水。产出信任的拿底薪，倒卖信任的吃全额分红，这账面平得让人作呕。

这种拿苦力血汗来填补资本窟窿的玩法，根本经不起周期的敲打。等哪天签发机构脑子清醒了，发现自己是个倒贴钱的散财童子，摆在他们面前的只有三条死路。要么硬挺着涨价，结果被抢单的同行瞬间绞杀；要么闭着眼睛瞎审，成本压下来了，但整个网络的公信力直接崩盘；要么干脆掀桌子不干了，拔网线走人。无论他们端起哪杯毒酒，最后遭殃的都是生态：供货一断，应用撤退，所谓的验证手续费直接归零。#newt 

以前搞Web2的那帮寡头也这么玩，比如老牌搜索引擎白嫖媒体内容，最后还不是被监管教做人，乖乖交了版权费。但在今天这个口口声声讲究共建共享的身份网络里，签发机构连个上桌讨价还价的板凳都没有。那些拿着 $NEWT 沾沾自喜的玩家，真以为自己吃的是生态红利？其实那不过是底层机构拿命垫出来的虚假繁荣。等底下的基本盘扛不住撤退的时候，这层窗户纸一捅就破，手里的代币迟早要为这笔烂账买单。#eth $ETH

title: 砸钱打白工与躺赚过路费：掀开 Newton Protocol 的分赃底牌
subTitle:
在拆解 Newton Protocol 的这套逻辑时，我顺着那条所谓的价值链往上爬，看到了一个极度畸形的源头。真正把“信任”无中生有弄出来的人，是那些做实名认证、对接过官方数据的凭证签发方。他们搞定资料审查、核实真假，最后拿私钥盖戳，弄出可以流通的W3C凭证。这帮人是整个引擎里最先点火的，没有他们产出的东西，后面所有花哨的费用结算、权限划拨全是空转。可是，白皮书翻到最后，这群扛下所有脏活累活的人，在分钱的章节里却连个席位都没混上。
这根本不是什么排版疏忽，而是骨子里的算计。签发方在敲下回车键发出凭证的那一瞬间，就把所有昂贵的花销全咽进了肚子里——不管是人工盯盘、生物识别还是合规流程，全得靠真金白银去填。可等这份资产揣进普通用户的兜里，开始在各个应用之间反复横跳、疯狂触发验证机制时，每次掉下来的碎银子，全被网络运营商和金库瓜分得干干净净。当初掏钱把资产造出来的人，反而丧失了一切话语权，连汤都喝不上一口。
用做买卖的常识去盘盘道，创造出好东西，要么高价卖断，要么细水长流拿抽成。偏偏在这个生态里，这两扇门都被焊死了。签发方没资格按次收租，只能眼巴巴地指望那一锤子买卖的初始费。在一个谁都能进来抢活干的公开盘子里，这笔钱只会被同行逼得越来越贱，直至贴地飞行。凭证被反复调用带来的那一块实打实的溢价肥肉，却跟他们毫无干系。在整个局里，这群人成了最悲催的、纯贴钱的冤大头。#ETH @NewtonProtocol $ETH #Newt 
这时候把 $NEWT 玩家的底牌掀开，画面就更刺眼了。拿着代币的人，嘴里嚼着的所谓网络收益，扒开皮看，全是从签发方没日没夜的倒贴里抠出来的。策略验证能跑通，全靠当初审查时砸下的老本。这笔老本没溅起半点水花，就被账本抹平了。而持币者手里按时打入的红利，却是实打实、亮晶晶的。干活的人扛下无底洞的开销，看戏的人拿走全网的流水，白皮书对这套狸猫换太子的戏码只字未提。
咱们拿计算器敲一笔硬账。算个老实巴交的合规服务商，一年给系统供货100万份凭证。就算把单次审核费往死里抠，算它 5美元，一年下来就是500万美元的硬性开销。这100万个件在能用的日子里，假设平均被翻牌子50次，每次给系统掉落 0.1美元 的进项。你猜怎么着？系统金库一年刚好也搂进500万美元。做苦力的掏了500万，炒币的拿走500万。产出方拿个死工资，过手方吃满流水息，这两笔钱严丝合缝对撞在一起，冷酷到了极点。
这套靠吸打工人血来养食利者的把戏，撑不了太久。等签发方算明白自己在这个局里完全是个倒贴钱的傻子，他们能选的退路就那么几条。第一，硬着头皮涨价，结果肯定是被同行用低价按在地上摩擦，丢掉市场。第二，破罐子破摔，审核放水，成本是降下来了，但整个生态的信用底裤也就彻底烂了。第三，拍拍屁股走人，直接退群。这几条道不管走哪条，最后的结果都一样：网络里没货了，应用跑了，手续费断供。
以前的互联网巨头也玩过这种套路，比如搜索大佬白嫖新闻，最后还不是被拿着刀逼着吐出过路费；发卡银行累死累活，好歹也能在刷卡机上分一杯羹。可在这个标榜去中心化的身份网络里，签发方甚至不配当个利益相关方，只被当成无情的供货机器。那些手里攥着 $NEWT 的人，真以为这泼天的富贵是因为生态繁荣，其实脚下踩的全是签发方拿血汗钱垫出来的流沙。等沙子漏干的那天，这栋楼塌下来，谁也别想跑。

#newt $NEWT Newton Protocol's white paper puts forward the concept of “public liquidity, private execution.” In plain terms, it is just dark pool trading under a different guise, used to shed the burden of market makers. The idea is indeed ingenious: it aims to let large capital take depth on the open market while hiding compliance verification in the dark. But once this mechanism is introduced, the transparency of the pool is disrupted. Once some participants are proven to have “passed verification,” the remaining accounts that show no activity will stand out sharply, and anonymity collapses outright. In short, this is just using information asymmetry to tier capital.@NewtonProtocol #ETH $ETH 

A closer look at Newton's underlying logic reveals a fatal flaw: once this framework starts running, it will naturally leak a batch of derivative data that can be tracked. On-chain verification of BLS signatures is fully public, and outsiders only need to filter the interaction history of TaskManager a little to easily export a “clean list” of compliant addresses. In traditional circles, such compliance status would be highly confidential; but in Newton, it becomes exhaust from on-chain operations, broadcast across the entire network. Cryptography can help you lock down transaction details, but it cannot stop others from using statistics to identify patterns.

Viewed this way, $NEWT  faces a very large regulatory minefield. Even if the current price is still around 1.25 dollars, the hidden risks cannot be ignored. Enforcement agencies do not need to bother cracking any privacy at all; they can simply follow the trail left in TaskManager's records. Addresses that participated are directly labeled as “proactively compliant” and become重点关注对象; those that did not participate are automatically classified as “avoiding scrutiny” and treated as blacklisted. Neither side comes out well, and once users get involved, it is very hard to distance themselves from the association. The privacy cloak that was originally touted instead becomes a tracker that helps regulators sort people into categories.

To plug this loophole, the submission action must be moved from a single wallet to an aggregation contract, using batched packaging to cut off individual traces. In normal times, one only needs to keep an eye on two core indicators: the growth rate of the participating address cluster, and the degree of overlap in behavioral patterns. If the sample size is too small or the frequency of repeated use drops sharply, the probability of identity exposure will rise dramatically. I am not taking sides on the technical concept itself; I simply want to estimate how easily this mechanism can be linked and traced back. After all, when operating on-chain, you have to weigh how resistant your interaction footprint really is to being picked apart.

稍微扒一下 Newton 的底层逻辑就会看到个硬伤：这套框架只要跑起来，自然会流出一批能被追踪的衍生数据。链上验证 BLS 签名可是全程公开的，外人稍微筛选下 TaskManager 的交互历史，就能轻松导出一份“良民清单”。在传统圈子里，这种合规情况绝对是高度保密的；但在 Newton 这里，却成了链上操作留下的尾气，全网广播。密码学能帮你锁住交易明细，却防不住别人拿统计学抓特征。

照这个路子看，$NEWT 面临的监管雷区非常大，就算目前价格还挺在 1.25 美元，隐患也难以忽视。执法部门根本不用费劲去破解什么隐私，顺着 TaskManager 的记录摸瓜就行。参与过的地址直接被打上“主动合规”标签，成为重点关照对象；没参与的则自动归入“逃避审查”的黑户。两头都不讨好，用户一旦沾上就很难撇清关系。原本标榜的隐私外衣，反倒成了帮监管分门别类的追踪器。

要堵住这个窟窿，必须把提交动作从单点钱包转移到聚合合约上，靠批量打包来切断个体痕迹。平时只需盯紧两个核心指标：参与地址群的扩张速度，以及行为模式的重合度。如果样本量太稀少或者重复使用的频率暴跌，身份暴露的概率就会直线上升。我对其技术理念不站队，纯粹是想算一算这套机制到底有多容易被关联和反追踪。毕竟在链上混，你得掂量下自己的交互底牌到底有多抗扒。

title: Capital Is Moving — Here Is Where It's Landing Right Now
subTitle:
$321 million in ETH volume over the last 24 hours. That is not idle money — that is conviction pressing into a market that spent days coiling. Meanwhile the rest of the majors are catching a gentler bid, and a handful of small caps are ripping triple-digit percentages. Capital rotation is alive and well, and the question is where it lands next.

Start with the elephant. Ethereum printed $1,783.35 on Binance as of this morning, up 1.73% on the day, carrying a market cap north of $215 billion according to CoinMarketCap. That volume figure — $321.12 million — dwarfs anything the mid-caps are putting up and signals that institutional and smart-money flows are concentrating here first. The Robinhood Chain headline helps explain part of the urgency: over $70 million in ETH bridged in just one week since launch. Real demand, real withdrawals from exchanges, real conviction that ETH is the settlement layer institutions will route through.

Now zoom into the levels that matter. Over the past 72 hours, $1,713.44 has acted as the floor — the line where buyers stepped in every time sellers pushed. Above, $1,813.16 is the ceiling that has capped every rally attempt. The current price sits at $1,783.35, which means ETH is trading in the upper half of that range, pressing toward resistance with real volume behind it.

Here is the map. If $ETH holds above that $1,713.44 support zone, the structure stays bullish and the bias is that buyers continue defending dips — this is the area where a pullback becomes a setup rather than a breakdown. If price breaks cleanly above $1,813.16 with volume confirmation, that signals a range breakout and momentum traders will pile in fast. But if $1,713.44 gives way on a closing basis, the door opens to deeper retests and the narrative flips to defense. Right now, sitting in the upper pocket with volume elevated, the pressure is on resistance — not support.

Solana tells a quieter but still interesting story. $79.06 on the day, up 1.28%, with $112.55 million in 24-hour volume and a $46.04 billion market cap per CoinMarketCap. SOL has its own 72-hour range carved out: support at $76.29, resistance at $82.79. Price is mid-range, not pressing either edge the way ETH is pressing its ceiling. If SOL holds $76.29, bulls stay in control and the path of least resistance is sideways-to-up. A clean break below that level and momentum shifts to the sellers, opening up room toward the lower end of recent structure. The resistance at $82.79 is the level to watch for a breakout — until then, SOL is consolidating while ETH grabs the spotlight.

While the majors grind, small caps are reminding everyone where the volatility hides. CASHCAT surged 82.9%, VELVET ripped 48.9%, and TAG climbed 32.8%, all in a single day according to CoinMarketCap. Moves like this are capital rotation in its most aggressive form — money leaving stable positions and chasing momentum in lower-liquidity names. Worth watching, worth respecting, but the cleanest risk-to-reward setups still live in the majors where you can actually manage a position.

The broader backdrop matters too. The EU parliament just passed its controversial chat-control legislation, allowing private message scanning through 2028 — the kind of headline that historically drives interest in privacy and decentralization narratives. Zcash is targeting a July 28 network upgrade called Ironwood, which could draw eyes to that corner of the market. And on the security front, hackers attempted to backdoor an Injective npm package to steal wallet keys — a reminder that self-custody discipline is non-negotiable regardless of where price is heading.

The bottom line right now: ETH is the trade that matters most today. It has the volume, the headline flow, and it is sitting in the upper half of its range with pressure building against resistance at $1,813.16. If it breaks, the move accelerates. If it rejects, the $1,713.44 support is where the next decision gets made. Either way, the setup is live and the levels are clean.

The $ETH pair is one tap away when you want in — and the next few candles are where this range decides which direction it wants to resolve.

Stay sharp, stay liquid.

subTitle:
在币圈摸爬滚打好几年，对那些动辄喊单“改变世界”的宣发通稿早就生理性免疫了。这段时间，推特和社群里全在疯狂讨论刚上线的 Newton Mainnet Beta。我也凑热闹去啃了啃那份晦涩的白皮书，发现大家伙都在吹捧它的前置拦截机制和 Rego 引擎，但我反倒盯上了个冷门考点——Newton Keystore 里面那个所谓“用完即焚”的暂态授权玩法。
官方给这套底层机制包了个 Session Keys 的壳子，想彻底把短期代签这事儿给办利索。打个比方，这就好比你给上门的钟点工甩了个一次性密码，干完两小时活儿密码立马报废，或者你看她不顺眼，切个后台就能随时掐断权限。如今的链上简直是个黑暗丛林，这套逻辑不光能防住明抢的黑客，还能按住那些悄悄瞎跑的智能合约。乍一看，这套防御网确实香。
可凡事就怕细琢磨：这面挡箭牌要是自带后门，谁去监管它？从咱们散户的真实操作视角来看，Newton 描绘的那种“低门槛链上自动驾驶”，到了实际测试网里简直惨不忍睹。普通人去连一下这个临时许可，卡顿、掉线是家常便饭，操作流程被切得稀巴烂，压根儿没法顺畅跑通。
讽刺的是，那些拿了VIP通行证、跑着认证节点的巨鲸和高玩们，用起来却是另一番天地。人家挂着成百上千个并发任务，不仅稳如老狗，还能无限无缝续杯。这差距就太明显了：愿景里喊着普惠大众，落到实地全是对普通用户的无情劝退。现阶段的生态，说穿了就是个专供技术大牛和资本机构自嗨的高端局。
再瞅瞅它的代币经济学，一切就豁然开朗了。官方咬死 $NEWT 就是固定的 10 亿枚，哪怕天塌下来也绝不增发。这盘棋下得再明白不过：用绝对的通缩逼着大户去锁仓拿节点资格。本质上，就是用极度夸张的资金厚度来做天然筛子，把想来捣乱的女巫攻击和垃圾并发直接挡在门外。@NewtonProtocol 
得承认，这种靠真金白银堆出来的博弈模型，在防御层面绝对无懈可击，硬核安全指标直接拉满。但代价是什么？代价就是把毫无资金和技术壁垒的底层玩家按在地上摩擦，大家在面对这套高大上的临时授权时，只能干瞪眼。为了保全系统的绝对纯洁，大众的参与感被无情剥夺了。$NEWT 
讲道理，“代码即法律”这句口号忽悠了多少人？眼看着各种大所被黑、土狗盘一波流，所谓的链上铁律早就成了个破大防的笑话。Newton Protocol 带着 #Newt 偏要逆行，硬是在最终上链结算前加了一道极其严苛的审核关卡，把生杀大权提前了。这种愿意在工程底座上死磕的态度，比那些只会讲空气故事的庞氏盘子不知道高到哪里去了。#newt 
但这却引出了一个让人细思极恐的问题。当咱们在这个号称去中心化的旷野上，垒起越来越高的巡逻塔、编织出越来越密集的过滤网时，这到底是在驱逐野兽，还是在给自己亲手打造一副赛博镣铐？如果连发一笔交易、动一个意图，都得先被层层扒皮、审查、对齐，那咱们当初削尖脑袋冲出传统金融的牢笼，去追求那份绝对野生的自由，究竟图个啥？或许，套上这副由代码和严密逻辑打造的精美项圈，就是整个加密赛道走向所谓“成熟”的唯一宿命。#eth $ETH

translatedData.title: The Brutal Truth of $NEWT Staking for Node Operators: Newton’s Underlying Interception—Is It Really to Stop Hackers or to Restrict Retail Users?
translatedData.subTitle:
After a few years of fighting and clawing in the crypto world, I’ve long been physiologically immune to those promotional releases that shout about “changing the world.” Lately, everyone on Twitter and in various communities has been going crazy discussing the newly launched Newton Mainnet Beta. I also joined the fun and dug into that obscure whitepaper. I found that everyone was praising its front-running interception mechanism and the Rego engine, but I ended up focusing on a less-noticed point—the so-called “burn-after-use” ephemeral authorization scheme inside the Newton Keystore.
The official wraps these underlying mechanics in a Session Keys layer, aiming to make short-term delegated signing work smoothly and cleanly. Think of it like this: you give the on-site part-time worker a one-time password—after she finishes two hours of work, the password is immediately decommissioned. Or if you don’t like her, you can cut off her permissions at any time from the backend. Nowadays, the on-chain world is basically a dark jungle. This logic not only helps fend off hackers who try to grab things outright, but also restrains those smart contracts that run around quietly on their own. At first glance, this defensive network really does look appealing.

title: Newton 暂态授权的背面：$NEWT 极致通缩下，被折叠的散户与绝对管制的悖论
subTitle:
混在这个圈子里，对于那些动不动就号称“颠覆行业”的噱头早就免疫了。最近 Newton Mainnet Beta 的热度炒得挺高，各路大V都在拆解它的前置拦截技术和那个 Rego 规则引擎。但我把官方资料扒了一遍后，目光却停留在了一个很少有人深聊的底层组件上——Newton Keystore 搞的那套暂态授权。@NewtonProtocol 
这玩意儿的核心，就是想靠 Session Keys 把短期的链上代持给做扎实。打个直白的比方，这就像是你给上门喂猫的朋友发了一张限时电子门卡，两个小时后准时失效，就算中途反悔也能掏出手机立马作废。在这个处处是坑的黑森林里，这招不但能防住想偷家的黑客，还能把那些经常抽风的智能合约代理给管住。单看纸面逻辑，这面防御盾牌确实很能打。$NEWT 
但凡事就怕深究：谁来担保这面盾牌背后没藏着猫腻？站在咱们散户的立场去实际上手摸一摸，你就会发现官方畅想的“全民链上自动化”在当前的测试阶段是有严重壁垒的。普通玩家想去绑一下这个临时权限，三天两头遇到断连，授权步骤也被拆解得极其繁琐，毫无顺滑感可言。
再转头看看另一拨人——那些拿到了官方开发者头衔的认证节点。人家挂着几十个脚本跑得飞起，不仅权限续得极其稳当，掉线率也几乎可以忽略不计。这种反差就很搞笑了：白皮书里描绘得众生平等，落地后却成了一道隐形的门槛。当前的玩法，骨子里其实是一场讨好专业机构和技术大佬的圈子游戏。#newt 
顺着这个逻辑去看代币设计，一切就说得通了。项目方把 $NEWT 的盘子死死定在了10亿枚，而且绝对不可增发。这种死磕通缩的做法，摆明了是逼着参与者拿真金白银去质押换门票。用极高的资金门槛来把羊毛党和恶意攻击者拒之门外。
客观地说，这种把经济博弈跟安全深度绑定的路子，在链上是绝对说得通的，它用强硬的尺子丈量出了系统的底线。但副作用同样明显，那就是让底层参与者在面对“暂态授权”这种高级货时，显得极其笨拙且无力。为了保全大局的安稳，大众的交互体验被直接献祭了。
讲真，“代码即法律”这句牛皮吹了这么多年，大家眼睁睁看着各种金库被掏空、土狗盘卷款跑路，所谓的法则早就成了个笑话。Newton Protocol 带着 #Newt 试图在最终结算前强行踩一脚刹车，把生杀大权移到执行的上游阶段，加上一层理智的过滤网。这种做实事的态度，确实甩了那些纯粹搞旁氏资金盘的项目几条街。
但这却带来了一个让人后背发凉的悖论。当我们在这个标榜去中心化的乌托邦里，架设起越来越密集的安检仪、套上越来越繁杂的过滤网时，这到底是在保护生态，还是在亲手锻造一座绝对管制的无形监狱？如果咱们每一笔操作在广播出去之前，都得先接受审查、评估和所谓的“对齐”，那当初拼了命逃离传统金融体系、图那个自由野蛮的劲儿，现在看来是不是挺滑稽的？也许，向冷冰冰的代码和秩序低头，戴上这副精密的枷锁，就是咱们这个圈子走向成熟必然要交的投名状。#eth $ETH

translatedData.title: The Back Side of Newton’s Transient Authorization: Under $NEWT’s Ultra-Deflation, the Contradiction of Folded Retail Investors and Absolute Control
translatedData.subTitle:
Having been in this space for a while, I’ve long been immune to the gimmicks that constantly claim to “disrupt the industry.” Recently, there’s been a lot of hype around the Newton Mainnet Beta, and various big names are dissecting its pre-attack interception technology and that Rego rules engine. But after digging through the official materials, my attention instead stayed on an underlying component that hardly anyone talks about in depth—this transient authorization scheme engineered by Newton Keystore.@NewtonProtocol 
The core of this thing is to use Session Keys to make short-term on-chain proxy access robust. Put it plainly, it’s like you send your friend who comes over to feed your cat a time-limited electronic door card—two hours later it expires on schedule. Even if you change your mind halfway, you can still pull out your phone and revoke it immediately. In this black forest where everything is full of traps, this tactic not only helps fend off hackers who want to “steal the house,” but also keeps those frequently malfunctioning smart contract proxies under control. On paper, this defensive shield really does pack a punch.$NEWT

#LAB Please don’t underestimate the power of love at first sight. How much U do you think I need to earn before I can get back to you?
Back then, we went through everything—cut losses, liquidations, zeroing out—every single cycle. I even fell into the trap of those fake “chicken” exchanges that ran away with everyone’s funds. A couple hundred thousand in principal disappeared just like that. Now I only use Binance, “some Yi,” and “some Ma” as my three main exchanges. At least my principal is safe!
After breaking up with my partner, I hid in a rental and drank to drown my sorrows every day. Ironically, that’s what spared me from the 312 chain liquidations. Later, at the bottom of 312, I bought the dip—just like that familiar “cooling mat” everyone knows—turning over and over again on low-position chips, managing to climb back up. One battle, and my account hit seven figures.
After turning it around, I didn’t get carried away. I calmed down and spent every day reviewing the K-line charts, refining my trading strategy, and slogging through until now. My account—#ETH —has firmly stood above ten million U. No insider info, no miraculous sudden bull market—it’s all from one set of ridiculously simple, old-school methods. I literally forced my way to a foothold in the crypto world.
Today, I’m taking out the 6 trading commandments I carved into my bones and sharing them for free with everyone:
✅ When it rises fast and falls slow, the whale is quietly accumulating
After a sudden surge, it slowly drifts downward—most likely it’s a washout to build patience. Don’t panic and cut your losses. The real topping signal is when, after a surge with strong volume, it immediately slams down and prints a huge waterfall-like bearish candle—that’s the bait trap designed specifically to lure chasing retail.
✅ When it falls fast and rises slow, the whale is secretly distributing
After a sudden crash, it then drags along with sluggish small rebounds. This is not an opportunity to “pick up a bargain”—it’s the whale’s final knife, slowly handing out the coins. Don’t keep fantasizing “it already dropped so much—how much lower can it go?” In crypto, the bottom is always lower than you think.
✅ High-volume topping is not guaranteed to be over; low volume is the most dangerous
If there’s still sustained trading volume at high levels, it means funds are still fighting for control—likely there will be another push to new highs. But when at high levels volume suddenly shrinks and the chart turns dead silent with no one trading—that’s the real eve of a crash. Be late by even a step and you’ll get trapped deep.
✅ Don’t rush at the bottom with volume; sustained volume is what’s reliable
If one day suddenly pumps a big bullish candle with high volume, it’s likely bait the whale throws to lure you in. Only when there’s gentle volume expansion for many consecutive days—and it emerges after long-term low-volume consolidation—does it truly signal that big money has entered to build positions.
Too many people in crypto just crash around in the dark, trapped in a vicious cycle of chasing pumps and selling in panic. Why not talk to Teacher Jiang?

⚖️ R:R: where scalping and swing trade diverge mathematically

People argue about which style is "more profitable," but forget that they have different survival math.

Scalping lives on frequency and win rate. R:R is often 1:1—meaning you need to consistently make >55–60% of trades profitable, otherwise spread and commissions will eat your edge. What matters here is execution discipline, not predictions.

Swing trading lives on R:R. With 1:3, you can be wrong more often than right and still grow. The price for that is patience and the ability to sit in a floating drawdown while knowing in advance your invalidation point.

Conclusion: don’t chase someone else’s win rate from screenshots. Calculate your own formula. Low win rate on swing trading is normal. Low win rate on scalping is a verdict.

With $ETH  I calculate risk before entering, not after. NFA, DYOR.

📰 Crypto Market Hotspots Delivery

1. Japan plans to advance research on unlocking crypto-asset ETFs
The latest remarks from Japan’s Minister of Finance and Minister of State for Financial Services indicate that, amid the continued expansion of overseas trading in crypto-asset ETFs, Japan hopes to push forward relevant research into unlocking crypto-asset ETFs. At the same time, Japan is also working to bring cryptocurrencies under the regulatory framework of the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act. If subsequent policies are implemented, it would mean Japan’s crypto-asset market could develop in a more standardized and more institutionalized direction, which is positive for local capital and the expansion of compliant products.

2. Bitcoin spot ETFs turn to net outflows; short-term sentiment is cautious
Latest data shows that Bitcoin spot ETFs overall saw approximately $95.3 million in net outflows, ending the prior relatively stable pattern. By product, Fidelity’s FBTC led the net outflows, while VanEck’s HODL and Morgan Stanley’s MSBT recorded small net inflows. Although daily flows faced pressure, Bitcoin spot ETFs’ total net asset value remains at a relatively high level. The historical cumulative net inflows are still substantial, suggesting that institutional allocation demand has not experienced a trend reversal.

3. Ethereum spot ETFs end their streak of net inflows; funds pull back temporarily
Ethereum spot ETFs latest recorded approximately $52.08 million in net outflows, bringing an end to several consecutive days of net inflows. Fidelity’s FETH and BlackRock’s ETHA were the main sources of outflows, reflecting that some funds chose to realize profits after the recent rise. While short-term fund flows have become more volatile, the overall asset size of Ethereum spot ETFs and their historical cumulative net inflows remain resilient, and the market’s medium-to-long-term allocation logic for ETH has not been clearly weakened.

4. The Fed sets up five policy working groups; macro expectations may be disturbed again
According to the latest news, Fed Chair Waller has appointed leaders for five new policy working groups. Their research directions cover key issues such as communication strategy, the balance sheet, data sources, productivity and employment, and the inflation framework. This suggests the Fed may be considering deeper policy reviews and institutional adjustments internally. For the crypto market, macro liquidity expectations, interest-rate path judgments, and the pricing of risk assets could all be affected by these developments.

5. IEA cuts Russia oil production forecast; energy disruptions may transmit risk preference
The International Energy Agency has latest lowered its forecast for Russia’s oil production, citing ongoing attacks on its energy infrastructure that are putting pressure on refining, storage, and transportation. The IEA believes this situation weakens the outlook for future supply. If uncertainty in the energy market continues to rise, it may boost global inflation and risk-averse sentiment, indirectly affecting the performance of risk markets—including crypto assets. Investors should watch how crude oil moves and how it links with macro factors.

title: Altcoin Rotation Is Alive and Bitcoin Remains the Anchor
subTitle:
Every cycle whispers the same lesson before it shouts it: capital does not leave crypto, it migrates. What we are watching today on the tape is not chaos. It is rotation — the disciplined hand-off from one risk appetite to another that has defined every major expansion phase in this market's history. And once again, $BTC is the gravitational center from which all other flows originate.

According to CoinMarketCap, Bitcoin sits at $64,013.54 with a 24-hour gain of 1.72 percent on $1.05 billion in volume and a market capitalization of $1.28 trillion. That is not a number to gloss over. It represents roughly half the entire crypto market doing exactly one thing: consolidating near a level that matters. The 72-hour resistance on Binance is marked at $64,243.75, and support rests at $61,544.56. Bitcoin is pressing its nose against the ceiling as we speak.

This is where the Visionary lens matters more than the candlestick lens. Bitcoin dominance has been the metronome of capital rotation for over a decade. When $BTC grinds against resistance rather than rejecting violently, it historically signals that sidelined capital is watching and waiting — not to flee, but to redeploy. The breakout, when it comes, does not just lift Bitcoin. It opens the spigot into altcoins. That is the rotation thesis, and the data backs it up today.

Look at what is moving. DUCKY has surged 226.2 percent in 24 hours. CASHCAT is up 49.8 percent. VELVET has added 35.4 percent. These are not random pumps. They are symptoms of a market where liquidity is actively hunting for the next asymmetric bet. When money chases micro-caps with this aggression, it tells you the broader risk appetite is expanding. Traders are not hiding in stablecoins. They are reaching.

Now layer in the macro currents. Robinhood Chain pulled over $70 million in bridged ETH during its first week, according to CoinMarketCap's latest headlines. That is institutional-grade capital moving into new infrastructure, and it is moving through $ETH first. The Ethereum price confirms the flow: $1,776.03, up 1.29 percent on the day, with a 24-hour volume of $310.78 million and a market cap of $214.07 billion per CoinMarketCap. Its 72-hour support sits at $1,713.44 and resistance at $1,813.16 on Binance.

But here is the hierarchy that matters. Ethereum follows Bitcoin. Altcoins follow Ethereum. And the micro-cap explosions you see today are the tail end of a rotation that started with $BTC holding its range and building a floor. The entire structure flows from one decision: can Bitcoin clear $64,243.75 and hold it as support?

If Bitcoin holds above $64,243.75 on a daily close, the rotation accelerates. That is the signal that the consolidation resolved upward, and capital that has been sitting on the fence begins to move — first into $ETH, which would then test its own resistance at $1,813.16, and then into the wider altcoin market where the 200-plus percent movers are already showing you where the appetite is. Buyers defending this level is the foundation of the entire current setup.

If Bitcoin loses $61,544.56, the picture changes. That support is the floor of the entire 72-hour range. A break below it does not just mean lower prices for $BTC. It means the rotation thesis pauses. Capital retreats. The micro-cap fireworks stall. And $ETH gives back its gains toward $1,713.44 as the market re-prices risk. Sellers taking control below that line is the condition that invalidates the current structure.

We also cannot ignore the guard rails the market is placing around itself. The EU parliament's decision to allow private chat scans until 2028 is a reminder that regulatory pressure is not going away — it is becoming more granular. Meanwhile, the attempted backdoor of the Injective npm package is a fresh reminder that security risk in this space remains real and constant. Neither development changes the price today, but both inform the environment capital is navigating. Smart money prices in risk. That is why the rotation is selective, not indiscriminate.

The patient takeaway is this: cycles reward those who watch the structure, not the noise. Bitcoin at $64,013.54 testing resistance at $64,243.75 with support at $61,544.56 is not a moment to predict. It is a moment to prepare. The $BTC pair on Binance is one tap away when you want in on the exact levels where this cycle's next chapter gets written. The range is defined. The conditions are clear. The setup is live right now, and the resolution is closer than most people realize.

Are you waiting for the break above resistance, or positioning at support first?

Not financial advice.

Think in cycles, not candles.

translatedData.content:
Sometimes the strongest tailwind isn’t that the coin price goes berserk first—it’s that someone builds the bridge ahead of time.

In just one week, Robinhood Chain has transferred over $70 million worth of ETH through, and that amount doesn’t seem outrageous in a full bull market. But in this kind of cautious sentiment right now, I actually find it quite interesting.

Honestly, this shows one thing.

Many people say “applications are the most important,” but when it comes to actual implementation, money still flows toward Ethereum—the settlement layer underneath.

You can say $ETH  hasn’t been exciting enough to tell a story over the past couple of years, and you can complain that it’s slow, expensive, and old-school. But the moment real money goes on-chain, everyone still assumes it’s the safer choice.

My trader friend told me last night: don’t always stare at the coin price itself. Sometimes it’s more useful to look at whether the money is willing to move first. It’s more practical than watching a single big green candle.

I pretty much agree.

Right now, the $ETH  spot price is around 1787, up 1.67% over the last 24 hours—not exactly explosive.

But futures trading volume is already 17.1 times the spot.

That’s where it gets subtle.

The coin price isn’t getting particularly euphoric, but leverage is already getting busy. Then the market starts to feel like “calm on the surface, but packed underneath.”

In situations like this, I don’t like chasing. Seriously, I really do.

Robinhood choosing Ethereum isn’t sending the market a “mood sugar.” It’s just repeating the point again: if traditional platforms want to touch on-chain assets, they still have to take this route.

These kinds of news may not immediately send $ETH  flying higher in the short term.

But it will gradually deepen a consensus: even if you criticize it on top of it, when it comes to settlement, clearance, and taking on liquidity, many projects still can’t get around it.

My current stance is mildly bullish—but I’m not going in blindly.

If later the coin price keeps grinding while the news keeps landing one after another on $ETH , I’ll be even more willing to wait for a pullback and pick up some then.

Doudou just crawled onto my keyboard again. Even the cat looks more composed than I am 😅

The market turns faster than a book being flipped—keep a little position size. $ETH #ETH

#BTC Brothers with less than 1000U in capital, don’t rush to open a position just yet. Want to get rich overnight with a few hundred or a thousand U? Chances are you won’t last long.

But for the total beginners I’ve worked with, starting from 500U and growing to tens of thousands of U in a few months, none of them ever blew up their account once. The core is just three solid, practical lessons:

First, split your money into three parts and never go all in. Use one part for short-term trades, taking a few points and leaving; one part for trend moves, entering only when the signal is clear; and keep the last part as reserve cash, untouched no matter how tempting the market looks. Most people fail by going all-in. Remember, surviving comes before making money.

Second, only catch the main uptrend and stop messing around. The market spends most of its time in consolidation, and frequent trading is just paying fees. If there’s no direction, stay flat and wait; wait for a breakout, wait for confirmation, and when you act, do it with certainty. After making a profit, first take out part of it and lock it in—that’s when the money is truly yours. #ETH 

Third, iron discipline is everything. Cap your loss on each trade and exit when you hit it; when profit reaches a certain level, take out part of it first, and let the rest run with a breakeven stop; never add to a losing position, and don’t cling to luck and wait to recover losses. You don’t need to be right every time—if you execute strictly, making money is the higher-probability outcome.

Growing small capital into big capital isn’t about luck or overnight wealth. It’s about risk control, patience, and execution. If you’re still anxious over swings of just a few dozen U, can’t allocate positions properly, and can’t get a feel for the rhythm, then you’re still far from it. Knowing how to protect capital is much more valuable than blindly charging ahead.

#ETH Stop gambling! Start with 2,000 in assets and roll it up to 100,000+ in 2 months—low-risk profit methods you can copy even as a beginner.
Who keeps saying that a short-term 2x in the crypto market is just hype? I’m calling it out with my own experience—it's not about going all-in on a sudden surge, but about a “anti-instinct rolling-reinvesting method.” Starting with 2,000, I forced it to over 100,000 in February alone. The key is that I stayed steady the whole way—sleeping soundly too!
I used to be the typical “chasing-at-the-top” fool: I went all-in on those “high-volatility” assets that got hyped to the sky, fantasizing about doubling with one trade. What happened? In half a month, I lost 40% of my principal. Watching the account balance drop while doing night-time reviews, I even wanted to slap myself—back then I finally understood: in the crypto market, “staying alive” matters 100 times more than “making quick money.”
#LAB After suffering and reflecting deeply, I refined these rolling-reinvestment rules. The core is just two words: discipline! Not betting on a huge jackpot—but letting your profits “snowball”:
Never over-allocate: Each time only move 25% of your principal. For example, with 2,000 assets, put 500 in the first trade. The remaining 75% stays untouched forever as “life-saving bullets,” and you don’t touch the principal even if an opportunity looks irresistible;
Take-profit and stop-loss without hesitation: Add to your position when you’re up 3% decisively. Exit immediately when you’re down 2%—don’t think 3% is too little. In crypto, opportunities are never scarce. What’s scarce is principal that hasn’t been wiped out;
Reinvest profits: Keep the principal locked and unmoved forever—only roll the money you make into the next round. For example, if you make 100 on the first round, use that 100 for the next one. Even if you lose 2%, you only lose 4% total, which doesn’t shake the foundation. This is the real “lose profits to protect principal.”
Many beginners think “3% is too slow” and keep searching for a chance to “double in one go.” But have you forgotten? In the crypto market, 90% of people die by “going all-in and betting one time.”
The essence of trading coins is going against human nature: while others bet on luck, I rely on discipline.
If you’re still chasing and panic-selling in the crypto market, losing more than you make—or even don’t know how to control risk—don’t panic! I’ve been digging into this market for 12 years. The traps I’ve stepped into are more than the opportunities you’ve seen. Now I don’t just break down the rolling-reinvestment method clearly and plainly—I also share market updates and low-risk opportunities every day. Beginners can follow along and copy the playbook.
A rose is given, fragrance remains in your hand. Thanks for your likes, follows, and shares! Wishing everyone wealth freedom in 2026!

title: 杠杆驱动的空头挤压：BTC 放量站上 63,500 分水岭，但美国现货买盘依然缺席
subTitle:
🌍 宏观环境（美股收盘）

🟢 纳指 26,206.89（+1.30%）｜标普 7,543.64（+0.81%）｜道指 52,487.41（+0.27%）
🟢 费城半导体 SOX 12,960.00（+3.06%）— 但盘中最高见 +5.97%，收盘吐掉近一半
🟢 VIX 15.84（−6.27%）｜🔵 美债 10Y 4.54%
🛢️ WTI 原油 $72.42（−1.50%）｜🥇 黄金 $4,137.80（+1.64%）

🧭 全天真相：科技股拉指数，但涨幅是「盘中冲高、尾盘派发」。
🔴 NVDA 202.78（−0.66%）—— 半导体涨、AI 龙头收绿，资金是从 AI 芯片流向存储，不是普涨。
🔵 油跌金涨的组合 = 市场把地缘尾部风险交给黄金定价，不给原油。

🛢️ 国际形势与传导

⚔️ 地缘：伊朗发射超重型导弹，目标为海湾国家境内美军基地。但美股当天「交易员淡化伊朗战争风险」，高盛交易部门称客户对话中并无对 AI 投资的担忧。
🟢 降温面：美国官员称以军将在未来数日从黎巴嫩南部一个「试点区域」撤军。
🧩 传导：WTI −1.50% 没理会导弹，黄金 +1.64% 独自抢跑 —— 风险溢价只进贵金属，没进能源。这说明市场认定「有摩擦、无断供」。

🔥 存储板块的重磅新闻（明日主角）
🔴 美国商务部长卢特尼克公开敦促三星电子与 SK 海力士扩大在美国的存储芯片产能，并证实正在与两家商谈。
🧩 接上本周美光「2035 年前在美投资逾 2,500 亿美元」——一周之内，全球三大存储厂被推向同一个方向：扩产。
🔵 这是供给端的中期利空，短期不改情绪，账在 12–18 个月后结。

🔵 中国：兆易创新 H1 净利预增约 1,099%，工业富联预增 93%–101%。

📊 Crypto 多周期技术面

💰 BTC $63,917（+3.54% / 24h 61,699.6–64,035.0）
🟢 1D：MA20 61,770 已站上｜RSI 52.7（早间 49.5）｜MACD 柱转正 +595
🟢 4H：RSI 60.6｜MACD 柱 +63.8 上行｜BOLL 上轨外
🟡 1H：RSI 69.0 —— 逼近超买
🔴 大排列仍是空头：MA50 65,390 ＜ MA100 70,730 ＜ MA200 74,149

⭐ 今晚的关键事实：加州 18:00（01:00 UTC）那根 1H 线放量 1.96 倍上破早报点名的分水岭 63,500，收 63,731；次一小时最高 64,035、量比 1.31 倍。
🧭 这不是缩量假突破 —— 早报框架的多头扳机，按它自己的规则，触发了。

💰 ETH $1,771.7（+2.64%）
🟡 正卡在 1D MA50 = 1,774 —— 早间还在下方，现在贴着它。RSI 54.3。
🔴 4H MACD 柱 −1.47 仍为负 = 上攻动能最弱的一条腿。

💰 SOL $78.91（+2.51%）
🟡 4H 仍偏空纠缠，MACD 柱 −0.02。三者中跟涨、不领涨。

📉 衍生品结构

💥 24h 全网爆仓（多空分开看）
🔴 BTC $101.9M —— 空头爆 $89.8M vs 多头爆 $12.1M ＝ 7.41 : 1（早间才 2.70 : 1）
🔴 近 4H 空爆 $45.8M vs 多爆 $1.6M ≈ 28 : 1
🔴 ETH $33.8M（空 : 多 = 2.90 : 1）｜SOL $4.7M（2.89 : 1）

📈 未平仓合约 OI
🟢 BTC $93.44B（早间 $91.1B），24h +3.31%
🔵 ETH $47.93B（+1.15%）｜SOL $10.45B（−0.22%）

🧩 价格涨 + OI 涨 + 空头被爆 = 不只是空头回补，有新多头进场建仓。

⚖️ 资金费率（仍然温和，没有过热）
🟡 BTC 主流永续 +0.0053% ~ +0.0074% / 8h
🟡 ETH +0.0041%｜SOL +0.0009%
🧭 多头没付出代价 = 这波拉升还没到需要警惕「多头拥挤」的程度。

🎯 BTC 核心指标

🔴 美国现货溢价 −$48.9 / −0.0765%（早间 −$61.6 / −0.098%）
🧩 折价在收窄，但没转正。美国机构现货买盘依然缺席 —— 这波突破是离岸盘 + 衍生品推的，不是机构在收货。

😱 恐惧贪婪指数 23（昨 22）—— 仍在「极度恐惧」区
🧭 价格 24h 涨 3.5%、爆了 9 千万美金空头，情绪指标纹丝不动。价格与情绪背离。

🎲 期权
🔵 DVOL 37.1（早间 37.8，24h 前 39.8）—— 波动率溢价继续被挤出
🔵 Max Pain：7/10 到期 = 62,000（PCR 0.97）｜7/17 = 62,000（PCR 0.64）｜月度 7/31 = 64,000（PCR 0.41）
🟡 现价 63,917 已站在明日到期 Max Pain 上方约 1,900 点 —— 明天到期后，指向 62,000 的「钉价」引力解除。

🔵 关键均线：MA20 日线 61,770（支撑）｜MA50 日线 65,390（下一道天花板）

🧭 综合判断

早报给的框架是：63,500 是分水岭，放量站稳 → 看 MA50 65,400。
✅ 今晚它放量站上去了（1.96 倍量）。按规则，框架转为「中性偏多，看向 65,400」。
⚠️ 但有两条不确认信号：
🔴 一、现货仍是折价 —— 没有美国现货接力。
🔴 二、OI 涨到 934 亿美元、恐贪却停在 23 —— 推动力来自杠杆，不是信念。

🧩 本质：这是一场杠杆驱动的空头挤压。多头目前有效，但脆弱。
真正的多空定价点在 65,390（日线 MA50），那里是空头主场。

💡 今日交易建议

🟢 多头思路：63,500 上方持有；止损＝1H 收回 63,200 下方；目标 65,400（MA50），触及先减一半。
🔴 空头思路：不要在 63.9k 追空（4H/1H 全多头、空头 4 小时被爆 28:1）。
　　A 级空区＝反抽 65,000–65,400 被 MA50 拒绝时进场
　　止损 66,300（日线收上 MA50 即作废）
　　目标 63,500 → 62,400 → 61,500
❌ 框架失效条件：日线收上 65,400 且现货溢价转正 → 整套空头逻辑作废，改看 68,000–70,000 的 Call 墙。

🟡 ETH：卡在 MA50 1,774。收上并站稳 → 补涨；被拒 → 空 ETH 优于空 BTC（4H 动能最弱）。空点 1,790–1,830 被拒，止损 1,865，目标 1,660 → 1,620。

⚖️ 仓位：不超过 30%。明天 SK 海力士 ADR 上市 + 周末流动性变薄，不要重仓过夜。

⚠️ 风险事件（7/10 周五）

🔥 SK 海力士 ADR（SKHY）纳斯达克上市首日 —— 时间待定，今晚最大变量
　🔵 定价 $149/ADR（较韩股周四收盘溢价 3.1%）
　🔵 募资规模由 43 万亿韩元下调至 40 万亿韩元
　🟢 认购需求近 2,000 亿美元、逾 500 家机构；前十大账户拿走近一半配售（筹码高度集中）
　🟢 分析师 Douglas Kim：ADR 短期对韩股溢价或高达 17%（多 ADR、空韩股的配对交易）

⭐ 但今天韩股盘中给出了另一个信号：
　🔴 KOSPI +3.91%（7,576.91）、三星电子 +4.32%，而 SK 海力士只涨 0.96%，盘中一度翻绿 −0.7%
　🧩 在自己 ADR 上市的前一天，龙头跑输大盘 3 个百分点 —— 稀释正在被定价。

📅 其余日程
🔵 IEA 月度原油市场报告（加州 01:00）
🔵 加拿大 6 月就业（加州 05:30）
🔵 德国 / 法国 6 月 CPI 终值
🔵 美联储洛根讲话

⚔️ 地缘：伊朗导弹 vs 以军撤离黎南部 —— 双向且未定价，黄金已在抢跑

📰 Crypto Market Highlights

1. Nium Acquires Cypher, Accelerates Crypto Payments Integration
Cross-border payments giant Nium has completed its acquisition of the crypto payments platform Cypher. As the integration progresses, Cypher will gradually shut down existing consumer apps, the business card platform, and the CYPR ecosystem, with platform services being discontinued in phases. This move shows that traditional cross-border payment institutions are entering the digital asset payments space through M&A, though integrations often come with contractions of legacy business. For users, what matters most now is the follow-up arrangements for accounts, cards, and ecosystem services; for the industry, the trend toward centralized payment infrastructure is worth ongoing monitoring.

2. New Hampshire Rejects Bitcoin-Backed Bond Proposal
The executive committee of the U.S. state of New Hampshire has recently rejected a proposal to introduce “bitcoin-backed bonds” into the municipal bond market. The issuance was originally planned to be managed by Jefferies via private placement. The news reflects that combining bitcoin with traditional public financing tools still faces high policy and compliance hurdles. Even as crypto assets continue to penetrate mainstream finance, regulatory caution remains clear when it comes to entering public markets such as municipal bonds, and the rollout pace of related innovative products in the near term may still be relatively slow.

3. LISTA Goes Live on Ethereum, Further Opening Cross-Chain Liquidity
Lista DAO stated that the LISTA token is now live on the Ethereum network, supporting native holding and use. Users can also complete cross-chain operations with the slisBNB cross-chain bridge. This means LISTA is further expanding in terms of asset accessibility, liquidity coverage, and multi-chain usage scenarios, helping it reach a broader set of Ethereum ecosystem users. For the project team, launching on a mainstream public chain helps improve token composability; for the market, multi-chain deployment remains an important path for protocols to compete for capital and users.

4. Hoskinson Debunks Rumors of Leaving Cardano, Stabilizing Community Sentiment
Cardano founder Charles Hoskinson recently addressed rumors that he would “leave Cardano.” He stated clearly that the claims are entirely false—fabricated from start to finish. He also noted that the message has spread widely and even sparked discussions beyond the community. Having the founder personally debunk the rumors helps stabilize the emotions of holders and developers and reduces the impact of misinformation on confidence in the ecosystem. Today’s market is highly sensitive to the movements of core figures behind public-chain projects, and timely official clarification remains an important way to maintain community expectations.

5. Robinhood Chain Pulls in Strong Interest in Its First Week; ETH Demand in Focus
Robinhood Chain’s first-week launch has been active. Bridged-in ETH to the chain has exceeded $70 million, and the total value locked on-chain has also reached a high level. Daily active users and revenue data have risen in parallel. Market attention is on the fact that most transactions on the chain are denominated in ETH, and ETH also plays the role of the gas token and the underlying fee payment asset—creating a sustained demand rationale as the ecosystem expands. If user growth and capital inflows continue, Robinhood Chain may become an important sample worth watching for ETH application demand in the near term.

title: BTC Is $124 Away From a $64,243 Resistance Test
subTitle:
Bitcoin is pressing against the ceiling. At $64,119.99 per CoinMarketCap data pulled this morning, $BTC sits just $123.76 below the 72-hour resistance at $64,243.75. That is a knife-edge — and in derivatives markets, moments like these are where the next directional move gets decided.

Let's unpack the mechanism.

When a major asset grinds into resistance with momentum behind it — BTC is up 2.82% in 24 hours on $1.08 billion in volume — derivatives desks start adjusting. Funding rates in perpetual swap markets are the mechanism that keeps futures prices anchored to spot. When traders are long and confident, they pay a premium to stay in position: funding goes positive. When shorts dominate, funding flips negative, and those betting against the asset pay the carry. Understanding which regime you are in tells you whether a move has legs or is running on borrowed time.

Right now the tape is telling a story. A 2.82% daily push on over a billion dollars of turnover does not happen without leveraged longs adding exposure. In a healthy uptrend, mildly positive funding is the normal state — longs pay shorts a small fee every eight hours, and the market keeps grinding higher. But when funding gets excessively positive, it signals crowding. Too many participants are on the same side of the trade, and the cost of holding that position becomes a drag. One sharp pullback can trigger cascading liquidations, turning a small dip into a violent flush.

The structural question for $BTC right now is straightforward: is this push into $64,243.75 backed by genuine spot demand, or is it a leverage-driven overshoot? The $1.08 billion in 24-hour volume suggests real turnover rather than a thin-market squeeze. That distinction matters because spot-driven breakouts tend to hold while leverage-driven ones often get retraced when funding costs force position unwinds.

Here is the level map. Support over the last 72 hours sits at $61,544.56. That is the floor buyers have defended — roughly 4% below current price. If $BTC holds above that level on any pullback, the bullish structure remains intact. Sellers would need to push through $61,544.56 convincingly to flip the momentum. Below that, the liquidation cascade risk grows and longs who entered late start getting margin-called.

Above current price, $64,243.75 is the gate. A clean break with sustained volume — not just a wick — would confirm that demand is absorbing the selling pressure at resistance. In derivatives terms, a confirmed break above that level often triggers short liquidations, which adds fuel to the move. Shorts getting stopped out is mechanically equivalent to new buying. That feedback loop is how breakout moves accelerate, and it is why a close above a key resistance level on high volume tends to produce follow-through rather than an immediate reversal.

Ethereum mirrors the setup on a smaller scale. $ETH at $1,778.87 is up 2.15% on $335.78 million in volume per CoinMarketCap. Its 72-hour support sits at $1,713.44 and resistance at $1,813.16. The range is tighter in percentage terms — about 2% to resistance — which makes the breakout-or-reject decision even more compressed. Ethereum tends to follow Bitcoin's directional lead on these setups but with higher beta. If $BTC clears its resistance, $ETH often moves proportionally more on the follow-through.

What to watch next is the funding rate itself. Derivatives data platforms publish aggregated funding every eight hours. If funding remains within the historical norm for BTC perpetuals, the push has room to extend. If it spikes sharply while price stalls at resistance, that is the crowded-trade warning sign. The mechanism is self-correcting: excessive funding makes longs expensive to hold, which naturally cools the move without needing a fundamental catalyst.

The macro backdrop matters too. Bitwise flagged that DeFi may be quietly re-rating against Bitcoin. If rotation capital is moving from BTC into altcoin and DeFi names — some of which are surging today, like DUCKY up 214.3% and CASHCAT up 56.2% — then BTC's resistance test could be less about organic BTC demand and more about a broad risk-on shift. That changes the trade structure: broad risk-on tends to be more durable than a single-asset squeeze.

The bottom line: $BTC is $124 from a level that matters, and the derivatives market is the mechanism that will amplify or reject this move. If support at $61,544.56 holds on any dip, buyers stay in control. If resistance at $64,243.75 breaks with conviction, the short-squeeze feedback loop takes over. The $BTC pair on Binance is one tap away when you want in, and the level above is where the mechanism decides the next leg. Not financial advice.

For the crypto market, the macro-level safe-haven pressure easing on a temporary basis can help boost market risk appetite. The hottest thing in the past two days isn’t just ETH—institutions are also piling into it as a “reserve asset.” What’s becoming increasingly pronounced is the mismatch between “paper gains” and “disposable cash flow.”

When large capital keeps treating ETH as a reserve asset, the most easily amplified thing in the market is the sentiment of holding on. But for everyday users, what truly determines the experience is often not your net value—it's whether, at the moment you need to use money, you can smoothly switch to stablecoins, withdraw in time, and complete payments directly.

Most people tend to fall into two common traps:
First, treating unrealized gains as cash, only to realize when spending is imminent that network congestion, route issues, and the timing of fund arrival are nothing like what you expected.
Second, preparing only a single route—when the market moves, you end up simultaneously facing both price pullbacks and friction when switching funds.

A more reliable approach isn’t to judge direction on the fly. Instead, divide your funds into three layers in advance: the position you’ll continue to hold, a stablecoin buffer that you can switch to at any time, and realistic expenses that you know you’ll need to cover in the next 7 to 30 days.

In this kind of market, what’s actually useful isn’t how well you can read K-lines—it’s whether you can turn “making money” into “money you can spend” ahead of time. 这两天最热的，不只是 ETH 又成了机构加仓中心，而是“账面升值”和“可支配现金流”之间的错配会越来越大。

当大资金持续把 ETH 当成储备资产，市场最容易被放大的，是继续拿住的情绪；但对普通用户来说，真正决定体验的往往不是净值，而是你要用钱那一刻，能不能顺滑切到稳定币、能不能及时提现、能不能直接完成付款。

多数人最容易踩坑的点有两个：
第一，把浮盈当现金，结果支出临近时才发现链上拥堵、路径不顺、到账节奏和预期完全不是一回事。
第二，只准备单一路径，行情一波动就同时遇到价格回撤和资金切换摩擦。

更稳的做法不是临时判断方向，而是提前把资金分三层：继续持仓的仓位、随时可切换的稳定币缓冲、未来 7 到 30 天明确要用掉的现实支出。

1. 1X Releases New Generation NEO Mechanical Hand, Spotlight Again on the Robot’s Precision Control
1X Technologies, a humanoid robotics company, announced the launch of its next-generation NEO hand system, featuring 25 degrees of freedom. It uses tendon-driven actuation and supports full joint torque control as well as complete backdrivability. The company claims its dexterity and torque control are nearing human-hand levels. The system integrates high-resolution tactile sensing to detect normal force, contact position, and shear force. It also meets waterproof and dustproof requirements and complies with food-safety standards. Coupled with demo capabilities such as assembly, grasping, and plugging, along with a production plan targeting 10,000 units per year, enthusiasm for robotic hardware mass production and the intelligent endpoint segment is likely to keep heating up.

2. Spot Bitcoin ETFs Turn to Net Outflows, Short-Term Capital Sentiment Remains Cautious
The latest data shows that spot Bitcoin ETFs overall recorded net outflows of approximately $95.3 million, indicating that some institutional capital has become cautious at elevated levels recently. Among them, Fidelity’s FBTC led the net outflow rankings, while VanEck’s HODL and Morgan Stanley’s MSBT still logged small net inflows, suggesting the market is not uniformly weakening internally but rather becoming increasingly differentiated. As of now, the total assets net asset value of spot Bitcoin ETFs remains at a relatively high level. The historical cumulative net inflows have been significant, indicating that medium- to long-term allocation demand has not been materially disrupted; in the short term, this appears more like a shift in capital timing.

3. Spot Ethereum ETFs End a Streak of Net Inflows, Signaling a Periodic Cooling in Fund Flows
Spot Ethereum ETFs recently recorded net outflows of about $52.08 million, ending the prior consecutive net-inflow trend and showing that market risk appetite has eased recently. By product, Fidelity’s FETH and BlackRock’s ETHA saw more noticeable fund outflows, which are the main sources dragging overall performance. Although daily figures weakened, the total assets net asset value and historical cumulative net inflows of spot Ethereum ETFs are still in a relatively high range, suggesting that the institutional allocation base remains intact. In the short term, it’s worth watching whether outflows persist and how these changes may further affect ETH price elasticity and overall market sentiment.

📌 Xue Hongyan: Survival rules for A-shares under K-shaped differentiation

🍖 Chopper says:
Today I read Xue Hongyan’s article, and I have to say it really resonated with me. A-shares are clearly showing a K-shaped split right now: on one side, sectors like innovative drugs and semiconductors are staging a strong rebound—Blue Sail Technologies jumped directly by 14 points today to hit a historic high. On the other side, traditional industries are just lying flat and not moving. This is kind of similar to what’s happening in the crypto market. Bitcoin ($BTC) has been moving sideways around more than $60,000, fluctuating. But coins like Solana ($SOL), which have real-world applications and an ecosystem, have recently been noticeably stronger than the broader market, with capital clustering in places perceived as more certain.

Let’s take the healthcare sector as an example. Today’s strength in innovative drugs has policy support—regularization of医保 negotiations is a positive for leading companies. Today's market rebound is interesting.

BTC is up 1.79%, and ETH is even stronger—2.60%.

But what about SOL? It’s down 0.17%.

In a market driven by extreme fear, and with both being mainstream tokens, ETH and SOL have moved in completely opposite directions on the daily chart. This isn’t a coincidence.

What’s the key difference?

👉 ETH has ETF support—institutions get passively flowing in, providing a backstop. During sell-offs, institutions defend the downside; during rebounds, the upside elasticity is stronger.
👉 SOL is more community- and Meme-culture-driven. In extreme sentiment, community hype fades faster, and selling pressure becomes heavier.

But from another angle—
If SOL can’t drop much, does that suggest sell pressure may already be exhausted?
If ETH is rallying strongly, is it just a short-term effect from ETF inflows?

So which one is truly worth holding?

There’s no standard answer. But here’s a simple way to judge:

Look at TVL (total value locked). A chain whose TVL keeps growing— even if the token price falls—shows that real demand is still there. If TVL shrinks, even if prices surge, it’s only a bubble.

Which one do you think more highly of? Share your logic in the comments.

What’s truly scarce isn’t more trading pairs—it’s keeping capital from going idle
I’ve recently been looking at GRVT, and the most interesting part isn’t how many more trading products it has added. Instead, it’s that it’s answering a more practical question again: **After money is put into a trading platform, why can you only do one thing with it? #BTC 
In traditional experiences, capital is usually split into several parts: one sits waiting for opportunities, one is used to earn yield, and one is held as collateral for derivatives. When the market suddenly moves, you still have to redeem, transfer, and wait. Every extra step creates time costs and leaves some portion of funds idle for the long term.
GRVT’s goal with One Balance is to reconnect these fragmented scenarios. The same balance can keep generating yield while also supporting trading and investing. In this way, returns aren’t an add-on outside of trading—they become part of how the account operates.
And it’s not just about removing a few buttons in the UI. GRVT uses a hybrid architecture with off-chain matching and on-chain settlement: off-chain for speed, on-chain for settlement and verifiability, along with self-custody. The aim is to strike a balance between CEX execution efficiency and DEX asset control. It has now extended from crypto perpetuals into spot, stocks, commodities, FX perps, and RWA yield products—the puzzle pieces are gradually coming together. #ETH 
I think what’s truly worth watching about GRVT isn’t whether it has “enough features,” but whether those features can cooperate around a single balance. Exchanges used to compete over liquidity and fees. The next phase may be about capital productivity: who can make every dollar users have wait less, move less, and work more—then it’s easier to retain capital.
Of course, self-custody doesn’t mean there’s no risk. Smart contracts, market volatility, clearing, and yield strategies all need to be evaluated separately. But the direction is clear: capital shouldn’t fall fully asleep waiting for the next trade. @grvt_io  is betting on this change.
#grvt

content:
真正稀缺的不是更多交易对，而是让资金别停下来
我最近看 GRVT，最有意思的地方不是它又增加了多少交易品种，而是它在重新回答一个更实际的问题：**钱放进交易平台以后，为什么只能做一件事？#BTC 
传统体验里，资金通常被切成几份：一份放着等机会，一份拿去赚收益，一份作为合约保证金。行情突然来了，还要赎回、划转、等待。每多走一步，都会产生时间成本，也让一部分资金长期闲置。
GRVT 想做的 One Balance，核心就是把这些割裂的场景重新接起来。同一笔余额可以继续产生收益，同时支持交易和投资。这样一来，收益不是交易之外的附加功能，而是账户运行方式的一部分。
这背后也不只是界面上少几个按钮。GRVT 采用链下撮合、链上结算的混合架构：链下负责速度，链上负责结算与可验证性，再配合自托管，试图在 CEX 的执行效率和 DEX 的资产控制之间找到平衡。如今它又从加密永续延伸到现货、股票、商品、外汇永续和 RWA 收益产品，拼图正在逐渐完整。#ETH 
我认为 GRVT 真正值得观察的，不是“功能够不够多”，而是这些功能能不能围绕一个余额协同起来。交易所过去争的是流动性和手续费，下一阶段可能争的是资本生产力：谁能让用户的每一美元少等待、少搬运、多工作，谁就更容易留住资金。
当然，自托管不代表没有风险，智能合约、市场波动、清算和收益策略都需要单独评估。但方向很清楚：资金不该在等待下一次交易时彻底睡着。@grvt_io  正在押注的，就是这个变化。

title: Cản $64,400 Gặp Biến Số Vĩ Mô: Eo Biển Hormuz "Tắt Đèn", Crypto Sẽ Ra Sao?
subTitle:
#oiltankersgodarkashormuzshippingslows 
Như tui có chia sẻ ở bài viết trước về việc Bitcoin đang retest lại vùng kháng cự quan trọng $64,400, đường đi tiếp theo của phe Bò và phe Gấu tại "vùng chiến sự" này có thể sẽ bị tác động lớn bởi một ngòi nổ vĩ mô (Macro) vừa xuất hiện trên bản tin thế giới.
Thông tin hàng loạt tàu chở dầu phải chủ động tắt hệ thống định vị (AIS) khi qua eo biển Hormuz do lo ngại an ninh đang khiến giới tài chính đứng ngồi không yên. Khi "yết hầu" năng lượng thế giới (chiếm 20% lượng dầu thô toàn cầu) gặp chứng ngại, dòng tiền thông minh chắc chắn sẽ có sự dịch chuyển để phòng thủ.
Đối với thị trường Crypto, biến số địa chính trị này sẽ tác động đến các tài sản lớn như BTC, ETH và XRP theo các kịch bản đáng chú ý:
Áp lực lạm phát (Ngắn hạn tiêu cực): Giao thương tại Hormuz chậm lại dễ khiến giá dầu leo thang, đẩy chi phí logistics và lạm phát toàn cầu tăng theo. Điều này có thể buộc các ngân hàng trung ương duy trì lãi suất cao lâu hơn, tạo áp lực tâm lý khiến BTC gặp khó khăn khi muốn bứt phá dứt khoát qua cản $64,400.Bản lĩnh "Vàng kỹ thuật số" (Dài hạn tích cực): Ở kịch bản ngược lại, nếu thị trường tài chính truyền thống (chứng khoán) xảy ra hoảng loạn, BTC và ETH có cơ hội lớn để chứng minh đặc tính trú ẩn phi tập trung độc lập của mình. Dòng tiền phòng vệ hoàn toàn có thể kích hoạt cú breakout mạnh mẽ cho Bitcoin.Cơ cấu danh mục dòng tiền lớn: Trong những giai đoạn thị trường nhạy cảm như hiện tại, những tài sản có tính thanh khoản và vốn hóa lớn như XRP cũng sẽ là điểm đến được ưu tiên khi các quỹ lớn tái cơ cấu danh mục để giảm thiểu rủi ro.
Góc nhìn giao dịch: Tin tức vĩ mô luôn mang lại sự biến động mạnh (Volatility) và quét hai đầu. Giai đoạn này anh em nên ưu tiên quản trị rủi ro, kiên nhẫn với các kế hoạch DCA hoặc lệnh Limit ở vùng giá tốt, tránh tối đa việc FOMO mua đuổi theo nến.
💬 Anh em đánh giá thế nào về biến số vĩ mô này? Liệu nó sẽ làm phe Bò chùn bước trước cản $64,400 hay sẽ là nhiên liệu giúp Bitcoin bay cao hơn?
Để lại ý kiến bên dưới để cùng thảo luận nhé! 👇

📰 Crypto Market Hotspot Dispatch

1. ETH’s Upside Momentum Faces Capital Confirmation
On-chain research institutions point out that if the market lacks sustained organic incremental inflows and stablecoin net inflows, Ethereum’s recent rebound may see momentum slow down. While current price action is relatively strong, whether capital can keep pace remains key to determining if the rally can continue. For investors, it’s important to watch stablecoin flows, on-chain activity levels, and the strength of spot buy orders.

2. “Whales” Buying ETH in Tranches Sends a Positive Signal
On-chain monitoring shows that a large account deposited $4.2 million USDC into Hyperliquid and initiated a tranche-based ETH purchase plan totaling about $4.37 million, aiming to buy roughly 2,432 ETH; about 40% has already been completed. The account has historically been in overall profit. This time, it uses a TWAP execution method, reflecting that large capital is taking a relatively cautious but clear position on ETH within the current range.

3. Easing Middle East Tensions Drives Oil Prices Lower
According to overseas media reports, Qatar’s negotiation representatives have arrived in Iran and will meet with Iranian officials to discuss easing regional tensions and encouraging broader negotiations. As a result, international oil prices fell in the short term, and market concerns related to risks tied to the Strait of Hormuz cooled somewhat. For the crypto market, a reduction in geopolitical risk may help improve short-term risk appetite, but negotiation progress still needs to be watched going forward.

4. Hong Kong Upgrades Virtual Asset Platform Anti-Fraud “Authentication”
The Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission is pushing virtual asset trading platforms and internet brokerage firms to strengthen account security. Key directions include disabling SMS one-time password logins and switching to higher-tier authentication methods such as device binding and passkeys. At the same time, it will also enhance monitoring of abnormal logins, withdrawal risk controls, and user risk reminders. This move helps raise the security threshold for the industry and shows that regulation is extending from license management into real-world operational risk controls.

5. New Crypto Regulatory and Financialization Developments Reported in the EU and the US
Market updates indicate that the EU plans to keep refining the MiCA framework and bring more tokenized assets and related issuers under regulatory oversight. Meanwhile, at the US local level, discussions are also underway regarding Bitcoin-related financial instruments, and another institution has introduced a native credit assessment model based on BTC reserves. Overall, regulatory fine-tuning alongside the financialization of assets is becoming an important theme in the crypto industry recently.

5. 欧盟与美国传出加密监管和金融化新动向
市场消息显示，欧盟拟继续完善MiCA框架，推动将更多代币化资产及相关发行主体纳入监管；与此同时，美国地方层面也在讨论比特币相关金融工具，另有机构推出基于BTC储备的原生信用评估模型。整体来看，监管细化与资产金融化并行，正成为加密行业近期的重要主线。

A fund—why can it only do one thing?
Many trading platforms compete on who has more trading pairs and higher leverage. But recently, when I looked at @grvt_io, it was a simple question that made me stop and think: with the same amount of capital, why does earning returns and trading always have to be an either/or?
#ETH 
If you put USDT into wealth management, when the market moves you have to redeem first, then transfer; but if you leave it in the margin account waiting for opportunities, it often sits idle. Each step on its own isn’t complicated, but combined they create real “capital drag”—what’s lost isn’t just time, but also the returns and opportunities missed while moving funds between accounts.
GRVT is trying to solve exactly this friction. Its One Balance approach isn’t simply subsidizing a trading account with a bit of yield. Instead, it lets the same balance take on multiple roles at once: the underlying balance continues to generate yield, and the upper layer can serve as trading margin; in the future it can also connect to strategy products and tokenized RWA. Especially starting July 14, eligible USDT balances will be automatically added to the new Earn on Equity by default, with a base annualized yield of 3.5%. There’s no need to lock funds, and you don’t have to exit yield status just to trade.
#BTC 
I think this is more worth paying attention to than “adding another high-leverage trading pair.” The next phase of competition among exchanges may not be only about matching speed—but about who can keep every user’s dollar from sitting idle for even a minute. Of course, returns are not risk-free, and the roadmap doesn’t guarantee everything will fully land; but if on-chain finance ultimately needs to serve real capital efficiency, the direction GRVT has chosen at least tackles a long-standing pain point.

$ETH Ethereum's recent 3 percentage point increase over the last 13 hours is the result of a combination of a crypto-wide relief rally, an ETH-specific short squeeze, and improving institutional and technical signals, rather than a single headline.
Ethereum did not move in isolation. Over the last 24 hours:
Total crypto market cap rose about 2.2%, from roughly $2.16 trillion to $2.20 trillion.Bitcoin (BTC) gained about 2.7% over 24 hours, climbing from around $62,600 to about $64,300.ETHEREUM gained about 3.3% over 24 hours, from roughly $1,740 to about $1,790, slightly outperforming BTC.
From the intraday data, ETH moved from about $1,744 at 12:00am UTC to about $1,791 at 10:00am UTC, which is roughly a 2.67% move over those 10 hours, with smaller gains earlier in the period rounding this to about 3% over the user’s 13 hour window.
Bitcoin retesting $64,400 and Ether up about 2.6% to $1,790 while altcoins like ZEC and AAVE also rallied, even as S&P and Nasdaq futures were slightly down. Derivatives data there shows falling 24 hour volume but rising open interest, and positive funding and cumulative volume delta, which together indicate an orderly risk-on repositioning rather than panic buying or forced liquidations for the market as a whole. 
Macro also helped. Coverage highlights:
The US dollar index has been softening, with a second weekly decline driven in part by a stronger Japanese yen and reduced expectations for near term Fed hikes, which generally supports risk assets.Middle East tensions that knocked ETH toward $1,500 earlier in the week have eased, helping risk appetite rebound. A detailed piece notes that ETH “rebounded sharply to nearly $1,800 after easing geopolitical tensions and a major short squeeze across crypto derivatives restored risk appetite,” with Asian equity markets (notably South Korea’s Kospi) rallying strongly at the same time.
In that backdrop, ETH’s move looks like the high beta side of a broader crypto relief rally. The whole market is bouncing off recent lows, but Ether’s rebound is somewhat stronger as it sits closer to a technical inflection level than Bitcoin.
A significant part of the ~3% 13 hour move is the “tide lifting all boats” dynamic as macro fears fade and crypto risk appetite returns, with ETH slightly outperforming because it sits near a pivotal resistance zone.
Several ETH specific flow and positioning signals turned more constructive, which helps explain why ETH moved more than BTC in this window.
Multiple X posts circulated data showing US spot ETH ETFs recorded about $70 million in net inflows on the most recent strong day, the largest single day inflow in roughly 28 days, capping a five day streak with about $162 million of net inflows into ETH products. An example is the post “Institutions are accumulating ETH once again,” which highlights those figures and frames it as renewed institutional interest.
A recap from CryptoPotato notes that spot ETH ETFs have seen their first multi day inflow streak since April, and that this has been a key tailwind behind ETH’s rebound from around $1,500 to just under $1,800, even if very short term flows have turned more mixed over the last 24 hours. 
This ETF demand is incremental spot buying that can push price higher with relatively modest size when derivatives positioning is light.
Santiment data reported by Yahoo Finance shows ETH’s exchange balance has fallen to about 4.32% of circulating supply, its lowest level since 2015. The article frames this as one of the “most encouraging signals” for BTC and ETH, because fewer coins sitting on exchanges limits immediate sell pressure and implies stronger holder conviction. 
Analysis ahead of the move notes that Binance’s 30 day ETH open interest fell by around 594,000 ETH, its deepest contraction since August 2024, while spot volumes on OKX hit new yearly highs. This is interpreted as leverage being flushed while spot buyers accumulate, a configuration that often sets up cleaner upside moves when demand returns. The same analysis marks $1,754 as a key level whose break could open room toward $2,440. 
MACD crossovers, and RSI above 60, all consistent with a momentum driven squeeze higher.
Additional X data points to whale address 0x2684 buying nearly 9,900 ETH (about $17 million) today and over 34,000 ETH plus 250 WBTC over the last 10 days from Binance. Large scale spot withdrawals like this both reduce on exchange supply and signal confidence from large holders.
With the derivative shorts largely reduced after the earlier selloff, spot ETF flows and on exchange whale buying biased to the buy side, and exchange balances sitting at multi year lows, it does not take enormous new capital to drive ETH a few percentage points higher once macro pressure eases. The 2.6–3.3% move over the last 13 hours lines up well with “moderate fresh demand meeting a thin and less levered order book,” rather than with a single dramatic headline.
$ETH  move is best seen as a continuation of a repositioning that has been underway for several days, where leverage was flushed on the way down and spot buyers (ETFs, whales, and long term holders) have gradually taken control of marginal pricing.

title: 探头亮了家却被偷：Newton 实盘测出来的链上风控真相
subTitle:
前几天拿小额资金试水了 Newton 的美债风控。跑的是 2 年和 3 个月期收益率倒挂就直接掐断 RWA 买单的策略。说实话，RedStone 喂价极快，触发点抓得很准，系统瞬间亮起红灯。但让人憋屈的是，这笔防守单硬是等到 AVS 算子慢悠悠搞完共识、签好名回传，黄花菜都凉了——那笔加仓早就已经在链上成交了。钱是没亏几个，但这种“眼看贼进屋，防盗门却卡住关不上”的体验，真的极其搞心态。@NewtonProtocol $ETH #ETH $NEWT #Newt 
很多群友遇到这事都在喷团队开发能力不行，其实真怪不到代码头上，这纯粹是底层路线的必然。Newton 骨子里挑的就是全节点共识验证这条绝对安全的赛道，压根就没打算伺候高频博弈。大家吐槽的卡顿，根本不是什么 bug，而是链上风控系统在“去中心化、安全、速度”这道三选二的单选题里，果断献祭了速度。
翻翻白皮书和技术文档就能理清这里的猫腻。它这一套动作得分四步走：交易意图先上链，丢给 EigenLayer 的节点群，接着节点去读取预言机跑规则，最后出具证明、打包签名再扔回链上放行。这阵仗简直跟过海关被拉进小黑屋查底细一样，处处留痕，没人能作假，但也绝对快不起来。你不能既要几百个节点互相监督防作恶，又要指望它像刷个门禁卡一样顺滑，这在当前的技术池里是不现实的。
隔壁几个同行的打法就完全不一样了。你看 Genius Terminal，直接走轻量化路线，把清算塞进链下 TEE 单机环境，速度直接拉到微秒级别，配合抗滑点机制，硬生生把极端行情的滑点死死控在 0.2% 以内。再看 ZKML 那边，把风控模型扔进零知识证明电路，0.4 秒就能出结果，Gas 费还能省下 62%。人家怎么做到的？很简单，直接砍掉冗长的多节点确认环节，拿一定程度的中心化去换取兵贵神速。
别觉得慢个两三秒无所谓。在链上那种吃人不吐骨头的极端波动里，延迟就等于给 MEV 机器人送钱。你的风控指令还在池子里转圈排队，那些夹子早就把你这点价差油水榨干了。等你的策略终于落地，盘面早飞到哪去了，本来想规避风险的，最后搞不好变成了精准接盘。这就跟你抢演唱会门票一样，付款页面稍微转个圈，票早进了黄牛兜里。
但你要说 Newton 彻底不行，那也是外行话，它的底牌恰恰就是这份“稳如老狗”。全链路都能查账，加上背后有 EigenLayer 庞大的质押盘子做担保，最适合接那种慢工出细活的单子。比如它跟 Massive 联手搞的 RWA 金库调仓，这种基本都是按天或者按小时算的低频买卖，慢个几秒谁在乎？人家要的是绝对合规不出错。还有和 Magic Labs 弄的钱包合规审核，卡大额转账和黑名单，也是同样的道理。拿着重型武器去切高频短线的蛋糕，纯属瞎折腾。
当然，目前的机制肯定得改。我个人觉得接下来的重点在于“看菜下饭”，搞分层验证。碰上高频清算、止损这种火烧眉毛的交易，赶紧开辟个轻量级通道——单节点 TEE 加上预确认，先放行再查账，把延迟压到百毫秒；要是碰上大额资金调拨这种输不起的局，再老老实实走 AVS 全量共识。预言机的更新频率也得分开设置。现在这种不管买白菜还是买黄金都走最高安检的死板套路，太浪费算力了。
这一圈测下来算是彻底看透了，去中心化风控压根没有既要又要还要的万能药。选了 Newton 的去中心化和安全，就得把“慢”字咽下去；眼馋那些秒级响应的方案，就得随时做好单点故障或者数据说不清的心理准备。玩家自己必须得搞清楚手里的牌：玩高频量化，就离全节点共识远点；替机构管钱，就老老实实走合规审查。说白了，链上这块地盘，所有好处都标好价了，就看你愿意拿什么换。

translatedData.title: When the sensor lights up but the house gets stolen: the real on-chain risk-control truth revealed by Newton’s live test
translatedData.subTitle: A few days ago, I tested Newton’s US Treasury risk control with a small amount of capital. The strategy was: use the inversion of yields on the 2-year and 3-month tenors as the trigger—if the yield curve inversion showed up, immediately cut off the RWA purchase order. To be honest, RedStone’s pricing updates are lightning fast, and the trigger point is caught very accurately—the system flashes a red light in an instant. But what’s frustrating is that this defensive order kept waiting until the AVS operator slowly finished consensus, signed, and sent the result back. By the time that happened, the boarding order was already executed on-chain—long ago. The money wasn’t lost much, but that kind of experience—seeing the thief enter the house, yet the burglar-proof door won’t close—is really messing with one’s mindset.
